description: Take a screenshot of the visible part of a shared tab. The tab is brought to the front first. Pass max_side=1280 when you plan to use click_at: an image above your vision limit is shrunk before you see it, which would shift the coordinates.

max_side.description: Scale the image down so its longer side is at most this many pixels.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.

name: screenshot
title: Take a screenshot
